title: fMRI study of brilliant moves in the game of Go
summary: Jesse Michels tells of fMRI study of brilliant moves in the game of Go, about unspecified at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: you know a study where you hook up uh somebody's brain to an fmri and they're playing the game of Go

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a study in which a person's brain was hooked up to an fMRI, a scanner that shows which parts of the brain are active, while they played Go, an ancient strategy board game. He brings it up in an episode about children said to read minds, as a way of asking where brilliant, intuitive moves come from.
